headline: US Air Force Cloud One platform reportedly breached amid wave of federal attacks
summary: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform. The report places it within a recent wave of attacks on US agencies, including the FBI, CIA and Treasury. Details of scope, attribution and access method are unconfirmed.

headline: SAP confirms cybersecurity incident following Der Spiegel report
summary: SAP has confirmed it was recently hacked, a day after Der Spiegel reported the incident. The source does not say what was affected, whether customer data was involved, or whether any products were impacted.

headline: SAP investigates suspected breach of its GitHub environment that may affect source code
summary: SAP is investigating a suspected breach in which unknown attackers got into its GitHub environment, potentially exposing source code. SAP has not said what was accessed or whether any customers are affected.

headline: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC allows unauthenticated remote code execution
summary: A zero-day in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed along with a proof-of-concept exploit. It lets unauthenticated attackers run commands on vulnerable servers, and no patch is available. The source does not report any in-the-wild exploitation.

headline: Japan's education ministry discloses breach of government procurement system
summary: Japan's education ministry said hackers breached its government procurement system. Records containing business information and email addresses may have been exposed.

headline: Suspected Vietnam-linked WeaveLotus espionage targets Southeast Asian government and military bodies
summary: SOCRadar has attributed a previously undocumented intrusion set, which it calls WeaveLotus, to a suspected Vietnam-sponsored group. The group targeted military, government and legislative organisations in Southeast Asia to gather intelligence on South China Sea defence agreements. Thailand is among the victims; the attribution is an assessment.

headline: pCloud Pass attack exposed some user email addresses and triggered login attempts
summary: pCloud, a Swiss company, says an attack on its pCloud Pass password manager has been contained. Email addresses for a small number of users were exposed, and attackers tried to log in. No details on vault contents have been published.

headline: pCloud confirms attack on pCloud Pass password manager after users report unknown device logins
summary: pCloud says its pCloud Pass password manager was hit by a cyberattack. Users had reported unknown devices connecting to their accounts even though two-factor authentication was turned on. The full scope and how the attackers got in have not been confirmed.

headline: open-vm-tools VGAuth flaw lets local users crash the service on guest VMs (CVE-2026-123917)
summary: A local user without admin rights on a guest VM can crash the open-vm-tools VGAuth service, causing a denial of service. The Amazon Linux record does not confirm affected status or whether a patch is available.

headline: Boston Scientific notifies people of data breach exposing personal and medical information
summary: Medical technology company Boston Scientific is sending breach notifications after a cyberattack exposed personal and medical information. The source does not give the number of people affected or how the attack happened.

headline: FIFA confirms it was hit by a cyberattack
summary: FIFA, world football's governing body, said in a statement to media outlets that it was the victim of a cyberattack. The source gives no details on scope, impact or who was responsible.

headline: Vendor article highlights security risks of unmanaged and forgotten virtual machines
summary: A sponsored piece from ISPsystem argues that forgotten VMs, unpatched servers and excessive permissions create blind spots in infrastructure. It promotes centralized management, access controls and lifecycle automation as mitigations. No specific incident or vulnerability is reported.

headline: Indian startup Matters.AI raises pre-Series A funding for AI-driven data security platform
summary: Matters.AI has closed a pre-Series A round, described as India's largest at that stage for a cybersecurity company. The company says its platform replaces several older security tools and uses AI to trace data lineage, analyse user intent and remediate threats automatically.

headline: Datasette-charts plugin released with automatic chart suggestions and Datasette Agent integration
summary: The new datasette-charts plugin suggests and builds charts from full query results using aggregating SQL, and it saves chart state in the URL fragment. Version 0.2a0 lets Datasette Agent create charts from chat requests. These are alpha feature releases with no security content.

headline: Malwarebytes offers Black Friday discount on consumer security subscriptions
summary: Malwarebytes is running a 50% Black Friday discount on its consumer and small-business security products. This is a promotion with no threat content.

headline: Schneier's Friday squid blog post opens an off-topic discussion thread
summary: This is a regular non-security blog post about giant squid in Newfoundland. It also invites readers to discuss security news. It has no operational security content.
